responsibility: This module provides the shared front-end infrastructure for GCC’s C-family languages—C, C++, Objective-C, and Objective-C++—covering the common work that sits between command-line/preprocessor setup and language-specific parsing on one side, and GENERIC/GIMPLE lowering and diagnostics on the other. Its main file families handle shared option processing and predefined macros, the cpplib lexer and preprocessing-only output path, pragma and attribute semantics, common tree nodes and semantic helpers, pretty-printing and dump support for C-family trees, construction and validation of OpenMP/OpenACC directives, precompiled headers, and front-end lowering via gimplification and UBSan instrumentation. It also concentrates reusable diagnostics such as format-string checking, semantic warnings, indentation and type-mismatch reporting, spellchecking and missing-header suggestions, plus support interfaces for target-specific C-family hooks, Objective-C integration or stubs, Ada spec dumping, and the standalone cpp driver behavior, making it the cross-language support layer that distinguishes shared C-like front-end responsibilities from the language-specific logic in gcc/cp, gcc/c, or Objective-C-specific modules.
